name: algovoi-jcs-conformance-vectors
description: RFC 8785 (JCS) + SHA-256 conformance vectors and runners for the AlgoVoi agentic-payments substrate. The runner_node.js files are ES modules; this manifest declares `type: module` so `node runner_node.js` works on any Node version. Install the dependency each runner imports (@algovoi/substrate, canonicalize, or the per-set companion package named in its header).
